texts.summary: Jacques Vergier to Monseigneur, probably Jérôme de Pontchartrain, letters of 10, 20, 26, 29 and 30 March and 6 (16?) April 1696. Vergier reports the Anglo-Dutch fleet off Calais, Jacobite landing plans, and his conversations with James II’s entourage; he also discusses naval preparations at Dunkerque.
